fact: The Ministry of Finance's Tresor Pay lets citizens pay non-tax revenues online by mobile money, bank card or Campost counters, and a Prime Minister's order of 28 May 2025 requires departments to use it exclusively within three months.
Licensed payment institution Konoom Cameroun plans to let users pay taxes, levies and customs duties from a phone once Konoom Mobile Money launches in the coming months, per Agence Ecofin.
AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY enables tax payments and e-government services, and the treasury of Cameroon is the only treasury connected to date.
ITWeb Africa reports the government launched SchoolMap, through which tuition and official exam fees at government schools must be paid electronically.
LeFisk reports that registration duties on 3 public-procurement acts can be paid online on registrations.dgi.cm by MTN MoMo, Orange Money or DGI OTP, with a payment notice generated by the platform.
